ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (light-gray/white) interior pixels to low-intensity (black) peripheral and axial pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity contiguous regions centered on the left and right lobes. These are bounded by a continuous low-intensity perimeter (5-15 pixels wide) along the trailing edge and a low-intensity vertical band at the median notch. A singular, high-contrast low-intensity focal spot is present on the medial-lateral region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 65 degrees and a vertex extending significantly toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, forming a jagged, non-linear boundary across the entire posterior margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature tapering to acute, upward-pointing lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: One distinct low-intensity circular pixel cluster (focal spot) on the mid-right lobe; no other high-contrast circular clusters are clearly distinguishable from image noise.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable low-intensity focal marking on the right lobe and significant irregular tissue-depth variations along the serrated trailing edge suggesting historical wear or minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast pigmentation 'fringe' effect where the dark trailing edge creates a sharp geometric boundary against the lighter ventral surface.
